name: rmsnorm-prefill-v5
description: Learned over 5 dreaming phases on the rmsnorm-prefill campaign. Depth 3 (R from beta); closes a branch whose best trails the round leader by more than noise x (2 + 8 beta) or whose last refinement stalled within noise; never runs a single-attempt step (re-roots instead); caps depth at 2 when the previous round's deepest attempts did not pay.

lineage: v3 stall close + no lone trailing step

caution: Trained on ~58 attempts of one op; it prunes aggressively. Prefer it when attempts are expensive; prefer parallel-refine to record a complete first tree. Learned in a campaign whose rounds started from the best attempt so far (round_root: best): its depth cap and lone-step stop assume a closed leading branch continues next round from the round best. Under round_root: origin that does not hold, so expect it to prune too hard there until dreaming adapts it.
